resources.name: grabient
resources.description: Use when someone asks for a color palette, a gradient, a background, colors for a brand, site, chart or poster, colors that go with a hex code, or gives a Grabient link. Finds palettes by words or colors, makes them from hex colors, changes one to be lighter, darker, calmer or warmer, shows a set side by side and gives each palette's link, CSS, SVG and PNG. Screen colors only: no print inks, paint, thread or colors taken from a photo.
